new.text: New is everything since you last looked.

chat.text: A chat stacks up. Tap to read every message.

earlier.text: What you’ve seen steps back to Earlier. Still in order.

burst.text: A burst from one app folds into a stack.

arrive.text: A new message brings its chat back to New.

check.text: Look once, and it all steps back.

end.small: Free and open source, for Android 11+
